description: Land Title Settlement Department - Uyandana - Bagawanthalawatta, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters for intestate properties, specifically calling for claims to properties of deceased individuals and providing detailed land parcel information including cadastral maps, parcel numbers, and land extents. It falls under the Land Gazette category as it concerns property ownership and land title settlement under the Registration of Title Act.
